column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-LEAVES-1.md item 5. Finding HARDENING-PIPED-CORE-PATTERN (medium, fixed): RLIMIT_CORE=0 is not enforced by the kernel for a piped kernel.core_pattern (core(5)), the default on systemd-coredump and apport hosts and inherited by containers, so the server memory still reached the handler; ApplyMemoryHardening now also sets PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 on Linux. Proof internal/hardening/dumpable_linux_test.go:TestApplyMemoryHardening_ProcessNotDumpable (real prctl state; red on main on the e2e VM, PR_GET_DUMPABLE=1) and :TestApplyMemoryHardening_NotDumpableFailureIsFatal; live server on the e2e VM: health 200, process_* metrics intact, /proc pid environ denied to the same uid. Tried without finding: setrlimit failure is fatal (existing tests); no Mlockall reintroduced (guard green). Not covered: root or CAP_SYS_PTRACE attackers and hypervisor reads (out of scope per ADR-098), swap (deployment-level per ADR-100), non-Linux hosts (RLIMIT_CORE only); docs/adr-098 still states RLIMIT_CORE works regardless of core_pattern (see LEFTOVERS)
